reasons: Position is safe: LTV 0.3839 is well below the corridor act level 0.7 and the 0.86 liquidation LTV, with a 55.35% price drop needed to liquidation.

The fired feed_stale screen on live is marginal (ETH/USD age 1202s vs 1200s max, +2s), and the pool cross-check (0.19% above oracle) shows no price shock being hidden by the stale feed; it should refresh on the next oracle update.

No market-level defect: utilization 0.5946 is below the 0.95 screen threshold, borrow APR is 0.57%, and pool/oracle are aligned, so leave_market is not warranted; LTV is already below the 0.5 target, so no reduce action is needed.
Base's Denim upgrade is scheduled for later today (18:00-20:00 UTC) with mainnet expected to remain operational; a watch item only, not a reason to trade now.

items.text: Testnet markets operating normally | The live, backup and demo markets on Base Sepolia (deployments/testnet.json) accept supply and borrowing. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.

items.title: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed
items.text: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed | On 4 November the team's lender supply returned to the live and backup markets (13 USDC each) and the demo market (5,000 dUSDC) on Base Sepolia, and the executor moved to 0xA9bbabE6d75C5BA96CA095586284774c9D09D18b (deployments/testnet.json). All three markets accept supply and borrowing; the live market's public Uniswap 0.01% pool again holds the team's price band. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.
